title: PT315-53 qualification evidence v2
$comment: Structural validation MUST be followed by semantic validation. The canonical Rust API is parse_evidence_v2. Schema v2 adds source timestamps, phased Firmware Auto readbacks, and exact baseline binding for matched workload evidence; schema v1 remains available separately.

path.description: The embedded release must equal kernel.release; parse_evidence_v1 enforces this cross-field invariant.

vermagic.description: The leading release must equal kernel.release; parse_evidence_v1 enforces this cross-field invariant.

protocol_checkpoint.$comment: The complete checkpoint is replayed and compared with this calibration by parse_evidence_v2.

response_deadline_millis.$comment: Must equal min(slowest_response_millis + 2000, 10000); enforced by parse_evidence_v2.

anchors.$comment: Adjacent median_rpm ordering is a semantic invariant enforced by parse_evidence_v2; JSON Schema cannot compare sibling numeric values.
